LLM menu selection (dd6fa1a68dea435590e989a79b03f889): The dataset is small with 90 rows, 4 numeric features, and balanced three-class counts, so a moderate CatBoost configuration is a safer first real model than deeper or longer-boosted variants. This experiment directly addresses the observed evidence by replacing the chance-level dummy baseline with a regularized tree ensemble. A switch to another family would only be justified after repeated real-model failures, which have not occurred yet.
